observations: Photo 0: a black three layer games console with a PS4 logo printed on the top right corner and STAR WARS printed on the front edge.
Photo 0: the top carries a white Galactic Empire crest and a red and white swoosh design; the three tier stacked body is the PS4 Pro shape, not the two tier slim or the slanted original.
Photo 0: two black DualShock 4 style controllers with touchpads and PlayStation buttons, a figure 8 power cord and an HDMI cable lying on top.
Small scuffs are visible on the top surface; the artwork may be factory finish or a vinyl skin, which cannot be told from one photo.
Not visible: the console powered on, the rear ports, the bottom serial sticker, a storage screen or the controllers working.
Photo 0 carries a Jiji dealer watermark (Game Arena Offical).

read_from: photo 0 PS4 logo on top corner
photo 0 three tier chassis matches the PS4 Pro; the word Pro itself is not read
photo 0 STAR WARS on front edge

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the PS4 logo on a three tier chassis, the PS4 Pro shape.

claims.claim: Ultimate gaming experience, smoother gameplay, faster
claims.evidence: Marketing wording; performance cannot be shown in a still photo, and no running clip is given.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, may show the blue light fault, or may overheat with a loud fan.
risks.proof: A clip of the console booting to the PS4 home screen on a TV with sound, with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift, dead buttons or worn batteries.
risks.proof: A clip of each controller moving through the menu and both sticks working.

risks.risk: Hard drive may be replaced, smaller or failing.
risks.proof: A screenshot of Settings, Storage showing total capacity.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest standard PS4 Pro storage

risks.risk: Console may be banned from the PlayStation Network or stolen.
risks.proof: A photo of the bottom serial sticker and a screenshot of a successful PSN sign in.
risks.if_unproven: as offline only, flagged for serial check

risks.risk: Star Wars artwork may be a vinyl skin hiding scratches or cracks, not a limited edition.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and a close photo of the bottom serial label showing the edition.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard PS4 Pro, no limited edition premium

risks.risk: Rear HDMI or USB ports may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close photo of the rear ports.

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting to the home screen with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
Clip of both controllers working in the menu.
Screenshot of Settings, Storage and of a PSN sign in.
Photo of the bottom serial sticker.
Photos of the rear ports and all sides.
response.reason: The PS4 logo and three tier chassis in photo 0 identify a PS4 Pro with two controllers and cables, so it can be priced at worst case as a standard PS4 Pro not working. A boot clip, controller test and storage screen would raise it.
